title: Reading the Buffered Input
statement: Let $x$ and $w$ be Boolean words, let $d$ be a one-work-tape configuration on input $x$, and let $s$ be a machine phase and $ip$ an input-head position. Suppose the original work tape is blank at every cell $d$’s work-head position plus $b$, for all integers $b$ with $-1\le b\le N$. Then, for every integer $a$ with $-1\le a\le N$, the configuration formed by overlaying the entire word $w$ on that tape and leaving the work head in place reads at cell $d$’s work-head position plus $a$ exactly the symbol that the buffer tape for $w$ stores at offset $a$.
hypotheses_covered: original work tape blank at offsets $b$ with $-1\le b\le N$
